#
 Spiritual
 Translation


**
¶2:**

…
how far the wisdom
 that proceeded
 from the Divine extends
 in
 its own
 realm
…
 each
 truth dwelling with
 every
 other truth in perfect mutual order forever
, and not
 one of them acted
 contrary to the law
 and
 arrangement
 that its
 companion
 truth
 had received
 from it
 in
 eternal conjunction.
 That
 is:
 where
 wisdom
 gov
erns,
 all
 its
 constituent
 truths hold
 one
 another
 in un
broken harmony, each
 serving
 the form
 that
 its
 neighboring
 truth sust
ains,
 without
 violation
,
 to
 et
ernity.

**¶3:**

However
, fals
ity —
 the advers
ary of
 wisdom — was condemned
 and overcome from
 within
;
 because dis
harmony arose in
 it, it divided
 against
 itself. Even its
 governing
 principle
 was divided against
 itself; and even
 the fac
ulties of
 evil
 that
 had risen out
 of the deep
est states
 of the
 merely
 natural mind,
 following
 after
 that
 governing
 fals
ity, were condemned
 because of
 the disunity present
 in all of them. Fals
ity was destroyed, and its subordin
ate powers were brought
 to
 nothing
, because the power of original
 wisdom operates
 according
 to the same law by
 which a
 ruling
 love gov
erns the
 external
 mind
:
 namely
, that whatever
 is in
wardly divided
 against itself cannot
 stand
,
 and whatever
 poss
esses genuine
 order
 within
 itself prev
ails.

**¶4:**

So
 long as the
 interior truths that
 share
 in the arc
anum
 remain
 con
joined with their
 ruling
 good, that
 governing
 state
 of wisdom end
ures,
 and all
 things
 within
 it perce
ive its excellence
 and it
 receives
 the
 manifest
ation of divine
 truth — and
 it
 surpasses,
 and
 is more
 elevated
 than, the
 opposing
 state of falsity that is
 about
 to rise
 against it.


**¶5:**
Yet
 that
 state
 of wisdom —
 the one whose interior truths are in
 mutual
 conjunction
 — is by
 its
 very nature compelled to judge
 and
 expose
 the opposing state of falsity;
 and the
 falsities are brought
 to nothing and fall
 under the power of the state
 of
 good-
and-truth that stands
 against them.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: [See] how far [the lig]ht that came forth from [the Father of Greatness extends] in that place in a [single realm] alone[, and they shared] the greatness of the light with one another for ever, and nor did one of them transgress the command and order that his brother had entrusted to him forever.

However, the darkness, the enemy, was doomed and overcome; because of the arising of disharmony it was divided within itself. Even the kingdom was divided within itself; [and] ev[en] the [powers that had] left their abyss behind and come up fo[llow-ing] it, were doomed because of the disunity that was present in all of them. The darkness was destroyed, and its other powers were humiliated, because the p[ower] of that first light functions in the same way as the kingdom of this world.

As long as its [associates in the m]ystery are in agreement with it, th[at] kingdom [stands firm,] and they marvel at it and it receives glory, the one that [possesses the light;] and it surpasses and is even more exalted than this other kingdom, which is about [to burst out] against [it].

Still, the kingdom, [the one that] its associates in the mystery [are in agreement] upon, is compelled to condemn that (other) kingdom; and the[y] are humiliated and come under the hand of this kingdom that is set up against it.
